decisions_settled.decision: INCLUDED — WANT TO SPEND ON SOMETHING? / CHECK HOW IT FITS YOUR PLAN BEFORE YOU BUY. / CHECK A PURCHASE

decisions_settled.implementation_note: computeSafeToSpend has no horizon yet; implementation needs a formula decision for the date. The authority shows the founder sample.

concepts.name: THE SURVEYED COURTYARD
concepts.preserved_intent: Spendable area vs held-back perimeter: the open, sunlit floor is the money; the shaded edges hold the commitments.
concepts.art_direction: A real courtyard of a limewashed cliff villa seen from the upper loggia: far wall with an arched opening to the sea, an olive spilling over, a linen-cushioned limestone bench, a stone basin, terracotta planters with lemon and lavender, a sheer curtain at the near edge. The sunlit centre is bounded by the arcade’s shade on all four sides.
concepts.composition: Figure set in the sunlit square (the money sits in the open area); survey corner ticks measure the square; the commitments are annotated on the shaded perimeter; actions and nav rest on the near loggia floor in shade.
concepts.held_clarity: BILLS (bench side), PLANS (basin side), GOALS (planter side), BUFFER (step side) annotated on the perimeter, plus HELD FOR BILLS, PLANS, GOALS & BUFFER under the figure.
concepts.logo: Official vertical lockup top-left over the plain far wall, multiplied into the plaster.
concepts.purchase_module: Frosted limestone panel, one row: question + line left, outlined CHECK A PURCHASE right.
concepts.wit: The emptiest, brightest part of the page is the money you can spend.
concepts.distinct_by: High overhead architectural view; centred figure inside the scene; survey annotation grammar.
concepts.previous_round_failure: An empty plan-diagram frame floating on blank paving, labels misplaced and doubled, logo in a pasted box.

concepts.name: THE ANSWER IN RAKING LIGHT
concepts.preserved_intent: The editorial answer: one plain sentence answers the question, set where the morning light falls.
concepts.art_direction: One thick limestone wall seen square-on, early sun raking through a deep arched window with an oak casement, sea and cypress outside, a lifting linen curtain; a travertine ledge with an olive branch in a hand-thrown vase and blank linen books.
concepts.composition: Left editorial column inside the light patch: SAFE TO SPEND → YOU CAN SPEND → $1,284 (the largest thing on the page) → AVAILABLE THROUGH OCT 18 → hairline → AFTER BILLS, PLANS, GOALS & BUFFER. The window carries the world on the right; actions sit below the ledge.
concepts.held_clarity: The sentence names all four holds; the held words are set in brass ink — only the words that hold money are metal.
concepts.logo: Official vertical lockup as the column’s masthead, top-left.
concepts.purchase_module: Limestone band with an editorial serif question and an outlined CHECK A PURCHASE.
concepts.wit: Metal means “this is held”: the material of a word says what it is.
concepts.distinct_by: Frontal elevation; typographic hero; asymmetric column against the window.
concepts.previous_round_failure: Text dropped onto a pale wall with an empty hanging brass tag and a placeholder maker’s plate.

concepts.name: THE SORTING RACK
concepts.preserved_intent: Sorting by category: what is held stays sealed; what you can spend is the only letter opened.
concepts.art_direction: A bespoke built-in cabinet of five arched oak-lined niches carved into a limewashed entrance-hall wall, a continuous limestone sill, four sealed linen envelopes with burgundy wax, the centre niche empty in a beam of light with the broken seal on its sill; a travertine console with a hand-thrown bowl and olive sprig; a glimpse of sea at the window edge.
concepts.composition: Symmetric: the figure centred on the plain upper wall, a fine thread drops to the open centre niche; categories engraved on the sill under each sealed niche; actions on the shaded lower wall.
concepts.held_clarity: BILLS · PLANS · GOALS · BUFFER under their sealed envelopes; the official botanical mark pressed into each seal.
concepts.logo: Official vertical lockup top-left, and the official botanical mark embossed into every wax seal (deterministic emboss of the official asset, never redrawn).
concepts.purchase_module: A cream stationery card with a letterpress edge.
concepts.wit: The empty niche and its broken seal: the only envelope opened is the money you can spend.
concepts.distinct_by: Frontal still life; classical symmetry; object grid with sealed / opened states.
concepts.previous_round_failure: A plain mail-rack with blank brass plates, a dashed debug border around the purchase module, clipped labels.
